profile_count_correction: Old optimization_proposal.json registered_scene_builds_per_evaluate=765 combined the wrong same-named scene function. Exact repeated_domain.scene executes10 times; research_synthetic_reuse_chain.scene executes765 underneath. Both rows are kept here with file identity; timing is diagnostic cProfile, not benchmark.

static_cache_scope.compile_once: Build the10 predeclared registered cases using current scene() and supported_contract(later=True) once per process before NativeSession starts; resident process compiles before ready. Charge this to cold setup.
static_cache_scope.retain: Private immutable tuples of case identity, sorted business ids, ordered CONTRACT_FIELDS scalar tuples, and canonical supported physical contract string. No mutable input dictionaries are returned.
static_cache_scope.every_identify: Recompute canonical(actual contract) and compare to frozen physical canonical; compare actual complete business keyset and every original field value to compiled tuples; require exactly one registered match. Python scalar equality semantics remain those of old per-field comparison.
static_cache_scope.mutation_defense: Freeze the field ordering and exact CASES/REUSE_COUNTS/HOLD3_CASES declarations at compile time; compare current immutable descriptor to it per identify and refuse changes. Source archive remains whole-dependency SHA bound. Never hash dynamic observations into a cache or memoize a guard result.

source_scope_after_authorization: foundation_repeated_domain.py: private immutable registry compile + identify lookup only.
foundation_repeated_native.py: explicitly timed cold initialize, detailed current-path milestones, no action scheduling change.
foundation_repeated_worker.py: time worker registry initialization before ready; old process behavior unchanged.
foundation_repeated_campaign.py: new performance/instrumentation contract and explicit initialization if needed; preserve historical archives.
tests: all actual evidence exact parity and mutation/refusal cases; no native started by tests.

timing_plan.clock: time.perf_counter_ns for wall, process_time_ns for CPU. Store ns boundaries and derived ms; native sim time stays a separately named field.
timing_plan.logical_request: At start of actual loaded-opportunity begin_new, before publication, store request_open_ns with actual owner root, target job/generation/traversal and later request_id. Keep it in audit-only policy state, outside actor observation/evidence. Close in finally after actual route/no-command handling and audit-record work.
end_to_end: request_open_to_submit_return_ms includes real fresh collection wait, intervening scheduling and native IPC.
request_open_to_controller_done_ms adds record/cleanup; distinguish guarded command, no_command, fallback, departed, expired and exception.
selected_activation_entry_to_controller_done_ms includes current ready callback processing only; it is not total fresh request latency.
delivered_ACK_observed_wall_ms and uniqueedge callback wall envelope, if recorded, are separate downstream observations; receipt sim times are never substituted for wall.
disjoint_ready_stages: collect_wall_ns: before/after collect(view), including native endpoints and current validator.
evaluate_wall_ns: separate domain.evaluate over all3 actions.
mask_wall_ns: complete protected deltas/local capacity mask.
inference_wall_ns: existing model prediction, including explicit zero/not-applicable and failures.
route_dispatch_envelope_wall_ns: before/after route_tray invocation, includes its native admission and client wrapper.
timing_plan.submit_boundary: Do not call route_tray envelope submit-only. Add an optional timing observer at the actual route client send boundary only if a shared-client hook can be scoped without changing authority; otherwise report exact native submit-only as missing and route dispatch envelope as measured.
timing_plan.body_timing: Keep worker residence/computation/poll/read and cold/shutdown separate. Body may already exist before logical request; do not add these intervals to full current latency or sum overlapping measures.
timing_plan.non_success: Record every denied/expired/fallback/error path in the same denominator. Separate positive authorized paths from cheap refusal paths.
timing_plan.concurrency_metadata: Record root task/native ledger identity, actual worker intervals and host/process conditions. No cProfile in performance runs. Do not run a second native collector concurrently.

verification_before_new_native: Compare entire status, reasons, seed fields, candidate completion vectors and final masks on frozen historical positives and negatives. Wall-only fields excluded from parity.
Cover all10 static cases, incorrect/missing/extra jobs, every changed business field, changed physical contract, repeated registry mutation and unknown registry.
Re-run .05 expiry, source ACK/headway/unresolved request, generation/traversal and same-timestamp resource-change negatives without changing their outcomes.

Source/archive binding/version pins separate R1 performance controller from the completed formal evaluation and original training contract. Frozen weights are consumed without retraining or reselection.
Only after pure parity and root registration: run paired old/new finite hold3 current paths under same conditions, full jobs/physics/protection constant; disclose cold setup and denominator.
claim_rules: No predicted 100ms claim before complete logical request endpoints are instrumented and measured.
A lower projection envelope alone does not establish full request SLA.
No claims of airport generalization, optimality, marginal RL gain or asynchronous benefit from this performance batch.
